name: Golkonda Aluminium Extrusions Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1988, Golkonda Aluminium 
Extrusions Ltd is a Core Investment 
Company.[1]
keyPoints:
Operational Status:[1][2]
The company used to be in the business of aluminium extraction, but it has not had 
any Aluminium manufacturing operations since July 2013, as the company had also sold land
 & building and other assets in FY17. Currently, the company is engaged in the business of investment, trading, financing, etc. of shares and securities

pros: Stock is trading at 0.48 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of -2.24% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
